title: Define decision owners and sign-off choreography for scope tradeoffs in PRD
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Establish a clear, minimal sign-off choreography and decision-owner map for upcoming PRD changes that include scope tradeoffs between latency SLOs, cost targets, and UX surface area. The goal is to reduce last-minute scope churn by making ownership explicit (who can green-light scope reductions, who must approve SLO waivers, and what legal/privacy checks are mandatory) and to publish a lightweight gate the Console and Runtime teams can follow during PRD review windows.
acceptance_criteria: Decision owner roster published and linked from the PRD (Engineering, Design, Legal, PM) with contact and backup
Review SLA defined: 72h for ENG technical sign-off, 5 business days for Legal exceptions, 48h for Design feedback for UI-affecting scope
Explicit matrix that ties scope change classes (minor, medium, major) to required approvers and rollback triggers
Sign-off template added to PRD with checklist items for telemetry, KMS impact, and rollout plan
Two rehearsal signoffs completed with one Dedicated and one Private deployment scenario
Console checklist updated and linked; product release notes template reflects acceptance state
